notes.title: Big update to the demo version before release
notes.content:
We have added a lot of new features to the game. There's not much left to do before the official release. 
We are currently working on bug fixes. If you notice a bug - please let us know. You don't need to close the game for this. We have added convenient feedback forms directly into the game interface.

Briefly on the main changes:
1. Added training, hints and Wiki page.
2. Added new, higher quality models of islands.
3. Updated icons for all weapons and most items. They are now of high quality. Enjoy.
4. Added new mechanics and gameplay elements. I won't spoil the intrigue. You will learn about them during the game.
5. A full-fledged story has been added. Starting a new game, you will have a specific goal.

New trailer and other videos on the game will be released soon.

notes.title: Big demo update: 0.73
notes.content:
We've added a lot of new stuff to the demo version of the game.
The main changes are:
1.	Dungeons. You can enter caves and some buildings. These are separate locations with their own features. Added monster eggs - a unique resource that can be obtained from nests in their caves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924927/ae56650961c6cf1ec1f4766dc3106bc5d229681e.jpg[/img]
2.	Support for Chinese, Japanese and Korean languages.
3.	Ability to automatically build and select buildings. Facilitates the process of moving to a new island.
4. lighting. Especially noticeable in dungeons.
5.	Redesigned weapon characteristics, the balance of different types of weapons, for a more balanced gameplay. 
6.	Fixing minor bugs and other small changes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924927/f2d145cadf8b9e697899d59e61d2280252331016.jpg[/img]

Old saves will work, but it is recommended to start the game again for a better gameplay experience.
You can support the game development on Patreon - https://patreon.com/FrostFireDev.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924927/54ab1ff7cd87c907ae68962b16b5115c4a3d640e.jpg[/img]

Enjoy the game!
